introduce:
Lie on your back with your knees bent and your arms stretched forward. 

Then lift your upper body off the floor. Hold for a few seconds and slowly return. 

It primarily works the rectus abdominis muscle and the obliques.
name: ABDOMINAL CRUNCHES

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Use your abdominal strength.
You will get better results if you do it slowly.
Relax your neck.
Always keep your lower back on the floor.
It's not right to use your arms to propel your body upwards.
To fully engage your abs, please don't use explosive strength.
Exhale when raising, and inhale when lowering.
If you feel it's too easy, hold a dumbbell in your hands.
You should feel your abdominal muscles burning.
You shouldn't feel your neck is sore.
It's a good workout for your abs.

introduce:
Lie down on your back, and put your hands beneath your hips for support. 

Then lift your legs up until they form a right angle with the floor. 

Slowly bring your legs back down and repeat the exercise.
name: LEG RAISES

tips.text: This workout should be done on a mat.
Raise up your legs faster and put them down slower.
Your back should always be flat on the floor.
Keep your legs as straight as possible.
Don't pull your shoulders up off the floor.
Exhale when lifting your legs, and inhale when lowering them.
If you feel it's too hard, put a little bend in your knees.
You shouldn't feel any pressure in your chest and shoulder area.
This exercise targets your lower abdominals.

introduce: Lie on the floor with your hands behind your ears. Raise your knees and close your right elbow toward your left knee, then close your left elbow toward your right knee. Repeat the exercise.
name: BICYCLE CRUNCHES

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Tighten your abdominals.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Put your hands behind your ears, don't interlock your fingers.
If you can see your elbows, please open your chest.
Exhale when lifting your body and inhale when lowering.
You should feel your abs burning.
You shouldn't feel too much strain in your neck.

introduce: Start in the push-up position. Bend your right knee towards your chest and keep your left leg straight, then quickly switch from one leg to the other. \n\nThis exercise strengthens multiple muscle groups.
name: MOUNTAIN CLIMBER

tips.text: We suggest you do this on a mat.
Bring your knees as close to your chest as possible.
Don't lift your hips up.
Take steady and deep breaths.
If you feel it's too easy, do it as fast as you can.
If you feel it's too hard, adjust to a speed that makes you feel comfortable.
If you feel it's too hard, elevate your hands on a bench.
This is a great full body exercise.
This can strengthen your cardiovascular system.

introduce: Start with your feet together and your arms by your sides, then jump up with your feet apart and your hands overhead. \n\nReturn to the start position then do the next rep. This exercise provides a full-body workout and works all your large muscle groups.
name: JUMPING JACKS

tips.text: Bend your arms to bring your hands over your head.
Start at a slow speed, then gradually increase the pace.
Your arms shouldn't be straight when you raise them above your head.
Inhale when your feet are apart, and exhale when pulling them back.
If you feel it's too easy, add weight on your ankles.
If you feel it's too easy, jump as high as you can.
Your back, glutes, abs, shoulders and calves all get involved.
It's a full body exercise to strengthen your cardiovascular system.

introduce: Run in place while pulling your knees as high as possible with each step. \n\nKeep your upper body upright during this exercise.
name: HIGH STEPPING

tips.text: Keep your upper body straight.
Do it as fast as you can.
Don't bend your back.
Breathe naturally.
To make it harder, raise your knees as high as you can.
If you feel it's too hard, slow down.
You can feel your heartbeat quickening.
This is a great exercise for your lower body.
This cardio exercise can strengthen your heart and lungs.

introduce: Start in the squat position, then jump up using your abdominal muscles for strength. This exercise works your abdomen.
name: JUMPING SQUATS

tips.text: Remember to use the strength of your abs.
Keep your knees extended in the same direction as your toes.
When squatting down, your chest should be higher than your hips.
Absorb the shock with your muscles when landing.
When you squat down, your knees shouldn't go over your toes.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
If you feel it's too easy, put your hands behind your head.
To get more of a challenge, bring your feet together when jumping up.
Too easy? Raise your knees as high as you can when jumping up.
If you feel it's too hard, use your arms to help propel your body up.
It's a good exercise for your legs and gluteus.

introduce: Stand with one of your legs forward and your knees bent slightly. Bend your elbows and clench your fists in front of your face.\n\nExtend one arm forward with the palm facing the floor. Take the arm back and repeat with the other arm.
name: PUNCHES

tips.text: Fully extend your arm with each punch.
Tighten your core.
Do it as fast as you can.
Breathe regularly.
If you feel it's too easy, hold a dumbbell in each hand.

introduce: Start with your feet shoulder width apart. Bend your legs slightly and lean your upper body forward. \n\nPut your hands in front of you to keep balance, then run in place quickly.
name: QUICK FEET

tips.text: Keep your upper body still.
Keep your core tight.
Take steady and deep breaths.
To make it harder, do the quick steps as fast as you can.
You can feel your heart rate up.
This exercise targets your quadriceps and calves.
It's a great exercise to improve your speed and agility.

introduce: Lie on your back with your arms at your sides. Lift your legs and keep them as straight as you can. \n\nThen quickly raise your right leg up, and simultaneously lower your left leg. Switch legs and repeat.
name: FLUTTER KICKS

tips.text: Please do this exercise on a mat.
Keep your legs as straight as you can.
Make sure your back is flat against the floor.
Tighten your core.
Breathe regularly.
Your lower back should not feel sore.
This exercise targets the abs and legs.
This exercise can increase core strength and improve your endurance.

introduce: Lie on the ground with your legs bent and your arms by your sides. \n\nSlightly lift your upper body off the floor and make your hands alternately reach your heels.
name: HEEL TOUCH

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your neck in a natural position.
Keep your lower back on the floor.
Engage your core.
Exhale when touching your heels and inhale when going back.
It's a great exercise for all of your abdominal muscles.

introduce: Stand up on the floor, then run in place while kicking your heel up to touch your butt with each step.\n\nTry to do it as fast as you can. It\'s a great exercise for the gluteus and hamstrings.
name: BUTT KICKS

tips.text: Please keep your chest up.
Please try to get your feet to touch your hips.
Please pull your shoulders back.
Please tighten your abs.
Please land on your toes.
Please try to do it as fast as you can.
It’s a cardio exercise that can strengthen your gluteus and hamstrings.

introduce:
Start with your knees and hands on the floor. Put your hands a little forward, widen your knees and put your toes together. 

Take a breath, then exhale and sit back. Try to make your butt touch your heels. Relax your elbows, make your forehead touch the floor and try to lower your chest close to the floor. Hold this position.

Keep your arms stretched forward as you sit back. Make sure there is enough space between your shoulders and ears during the exercise.
name: CHILD'S POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please make sure there is enough space between your shoulders and ears.
Please keep your arms stretched forward as you sit back.
This exercise gently stretches your upper back, shoulders, hips and legs.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs extended and your elbows directly under your shoulders.

 Lift your left leg up at a 45 degree angle while reaching your right arm over to your left side.

 Then slowly go back to the starting position. Repeat several times, and then switch to the other side.
name: RECLINED OBLIQUE TWIST

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please do this slowly to get better results.
Please keep your legs straight.
If you feel the exercise is too hard, you can put your legs on the floor.
If you feel the exercise is too easy, you can lift both legs.
Exhale when lifting your leg, and inhale when lowering it.
This exercise tones your obliques, abs and thighs.

introduce: Lie down on your stomach and bend your elbows with your hands beneath your shoulders. \n\nThen push your chest up off the ground as far as possible. Hold this position for seconds.
name: COBRA STRETCH

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Breathe slowly while holding yourself up.
This exercise stretches your abdominals.

introduce: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your arms stretched at your sides. \n\nLift your knees and twist your legs to the left. Hold this position.
name: LYING TWIST STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: You need to do this exercise on a mat.
Please make sure your knees are together.
Please always keep your shoulders on the floor.
Breathe regularly.
You should feel a gentle stretch on your opposite waist.
You shouldn’t feel any pain.
This exercise stretches your obliques and lower back.

introduce: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your arms stretched at your sides. \n\nLift your knees and twist your legs to the right. Hold this position.
name: LYING TWIST STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: You need to do this exercise on a mat.
Please make sure your knees are together.
Please always keep your shoulders on the floor.
Breathe regularly.
You should feel a gentle stretch on your opposite waist.
You shouldn’t feel any pain.
This exercise stretches your obliques and lower back.

introduce: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart. Put your hands on the ground and kick your feet backward, then bring your feet back and jump up. Repeat the exercise.
name: MODIFIED BURPEES

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your core tight.
Put your hands between your knees.
Bend your legs to get your hands on the floor instead of bending your body.
You shouldn't feel strain in your back and shoulders.
Do the steps of the exercise as quickly as you can.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
It's a great exercise that we highly recommend to you.
